newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot, Boeing sign plane deal Apr 3.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot, Boeing sign plane deal Apr 3.

text.p: Russia's Aeroflot-Russian International Airlines will sign a final deal with U.S. plane-maker Boeing Co on April 30 to buy ten 737-400 jets worth about $400 million, a senior official said on Tuesday.
Aeroflot's acting chief executive Valery Okulov said the planes would be delivered in 1998-1999.
"We will sign a final agreement on April 30," Okulov told a news conference.
The two sides signed a memorandum of agreement on the deal last September.
Okulov said the 737-400s would replace short-range Tupolev Tu-134 jets on Aeroflot's domestic and international routes.
"We need these planes to improve air safety and to make our flights more profitable," he said.
Aeroflot operates 12 Tu-134s in its fleet of 115 aircraft.
Okulov also said the Boeing deal would be Aeroflot's first major purchase made with Russian government financial guarantees.
